secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://xxxx.supabase.co) from the Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key from the Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role key (server-side admin) from the Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) > Get API key

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key from the Resend dashboard > API Keys (optional; admin email notifications)

secrets.name: ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAILS
secrets.description: Comma-separated admin email addresses for Resend notifications (optional)
